scrollbarMode.values: Case-sensitive options: showOnDemand, showAlways, showNever, showLeftOnDemand, showLeftAlways, showTopOnDemand, showTopAlways, showOnDemandShrink.
scrollbarMode.default: When omitted, the component, window style and native widget determine the result. There is no universal skin-wide default for this attribute.
scrollbarMode.context: This example requires an existing Python list component named list. For a Setup/ConfigList screen use its existing name="config" instead; XML does not create the component.
notes: showOnDemandShrink enables on-demand scrolling plus content-width adjustment. It is not a separate Boolean attribute.

For MultiContent, the affected draw rectangle must extend past the reduced item width; the engine subtracts scrollbar width + offset. It does not select the last tuple by its index. Right-aligned text then shifts inward.
A renderer/converter or screen can override scrollbarMode after skin application. ScrollLabel has its own mode parser; not every eListbox mode applies to that composite component.
Use the worked example when the last column or last item overlaps the scrollbar and needs automatic width adjustment; it explains which value-column drawing rectangles actually shrink.

</eStack>
spacing.context: Use on a native stack containing child widgets, or as structural panel spacing. For spacing between list items use itemSpacing.
